meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 给指定的 NanoClaw agent 装上 Dial 工具:agent 镜像内置 `dial` 命令和 `dial-cli` 技能,凭证由 OneCLI 按 agent 注入,被选中的 agent 就能在沙箱里发短信、打 AI 语音电话、收验证码。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 发短信、打电话或在聊天里运行 `dial …`,又不把 Dial 配成消息渠道时触发。需在宿主 NanoClaw 仓库运行(不能在聊天里装),且已初始化 OneCLI。

say.text: 给所有 agent 装上 Dial 工具
say.note: 会问你哪些 agent 可以用 Dial

say.text: 只让 ag-xxx 这个 agent 能用 Dial
say.note: 没选中的 agent 会在网关被拦截

say.text: 重跑 add-dial-tool,改成只允许 ag-xxx
say.note: 可重复运行,用来改授权范围

howto.what_en: Gives chosen NanoClaw agents Dial as a container tool: the `dial` CLI and `dial-cli` skill in the agent image, with the api.getdial.ai key injected per agent by OneCLI, so picked agents can send SMS, call, and get codes in the sandbox.
howto.when_en: Use when you want agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel. Run it from the NanoClaw repo on the host, with OneCLI already initialized.

say_en.text: Give every agent the Dial tool
say_en.note: You'll be asked which agents may use Dial.

say_en.text: Only let agent ag-xxx use Dial
say_en.note: Other agents get 403 blocked_by_policy at the gateway.

say_en.text: Run add-dial-tool again and let only ag-xxx use Dial
say_en.note: Idempotent; re-running changes who may use Dial.
